name: Nestle Close II
source:
The summer fades away and the leaves begin to change, but his way of living hasn't got any better. One day, he finds a live-in part time job to take care of his childhood friend's house. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024198.html]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
夏去秋来，树叶渐渐变色，但他的生活仍未见起色。
某天，他找到一份包住的兼职，负责照看青梅竹马的房子。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024198.html]DLsite English[/url]]
